Introduction

Junhyuk, born Lee Junhyuk, is a South Korean singer under Idol Youth Entertainment. He is member of the now disbanded boy group MIRAE and the Chinese-Korea boy group, POLARIX, formed through the survival show, Starlight Boys.

Before debuting he competed on the 2019 survival show Produce X 101. He later debuted as a member of MIRAE on March 17, 2021 with the mini album "Killa".
